Help
the assistant is the IDE's AI coding agent. Describe what you want to build and it will scaffold, code, and iterate with you.
Modes
Discovery — new conversations start here. the assistant asks clarifying questions to nail down requirements before writing any code.
Plan — the assistant researches the codebase and proposes a plan WITHOUT editing files. Toggle with /plan. Best for big or risky changes.
Execute — the default working mode. the assistant writes code, runs tools, and applies changes, then verifies them.
Tips
• Type @filename to attach a project file as context (or drag & drop any file).
• Type / to browse every command.
• Use /plan to have the assistant research before making changes.
• Use /undo to revert the last AI turn's file changes if it goes off track.
• Use /compact to compress context when the conversation gets long.
• Be specific — "Add a login page with email/password and Google OAuth" beats "add auth".
Press Cmd+/ (Ctrl+/ on Windows/Linux) to view all keyboard shortcuts.
